scope: Read-only follow-up of v4 policy handoff against the three design blockers from Luna v1. No actual outcomes, candidate-level adjudications, result admissions, or forecast data consumed.

pairCohort.inapplicableReason: No named principal-pair share distribution in this forecast; fixed before outcomes.

maineInitialChoice.newPolicyDefinition: Final corrected/certified initial-choice candidate totals before RCV Round 1 promotes a second choice when the first rank is blank. Do not use the unofficial partial Round 0 Election Day tally or the altered Round 1 RCV candidate totals.
maineInitialChoice.admissionSafeguard: The extraction must record the literal source field, source round label, and documented measurement semantics. If a controlling official artifact cannot establish initial-choice values, leave this pair measurement unavailable rather than substitute promoted/transfer totals.
maineInitialChoice.remainingOperationalLimit: No 2026 result artifact has been examined, so availability of a corrected/certified initial-choice source field remains to be established only when future results exist. This is not a policy-definition blocker.

deterministicPrinciples: Final official general-ballot/certified candidate designation first; official current filing/nomination/party-preference record only when needed.
D/R plus minor fusion affiliation maps to the major party once; minor-only maps O; dual D+R or conflicting/uncertain identity stays pending, not O.
Explicit official no-party/unaffiliated/nonpartisan or non-D/R designation maps O; a missing field alone is not None.
Write-in status establishes candidacy, not party; obtain official current affiliation or keep pending.
Use state-specific candidate-preference labels for CA/WA only as evaluation categories and expressly disclaim legal nomination/endorsement.
Do not use caucus, endorsement, ideology, prior party, FEC, media, or the forecast roster to resolve actual party truth.
partyTruthCodebook.candidateLevelEvidence: The codebook explicitly states zero of 1,209 forecast candidate identities are pre-adjudicated and all_candidate_records_individually_reviewed is false. This is a future per-winner evidence/admission task, not a claim of completed identity review.
